what.title: What is Ehlers-Danlos syndrome? 13 types, how common, the zebra
what.description: The Ehlers-Danlos syndromes animated: the 13 types of 2017, prevalence by type, who is diagnosed and how late, why the zebra, and what EDS is not.

collagen.title: Collagen in EDS: gene to fibril, and the step each type breaks
collagen.description: How collagen is built: Gly-X-Y chains, triple helix, propeptide cutting, 67 nm fibrils and cross-links, animated, with the step each EDS type disrupts.

types.title: The 13 types of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (2017): genes and inheritance
types.description: The 2017 EDS classification as an animated map: 13 types by pathway, genes, dominant or recessive, major criteria, a type comparator and old-to-new names.

genes.title: EDS inheritance and genetic testing: pedigrees, odds and results
genes.description: How EDS runs in families: animated dominant, recessive and hEDS pedigrees with Punnett odds, de novo variants, cascade testing and what test results mean.

beighton.title: Beighton score calculator: 9-point hypermobility test explained
beighton.description: Animated Beighton score: the five manoeuvres, 2017 age-adjusted cut-offs (6, 5, 4), five-part questionnaire, reliability and how common high scores are.

criteria.title: 2017 hEDS criteria: interactive checklist for hypermobile EDS
criteria.description: The 2017 hypermobile EDS criteria animated: Beighton cut-offs, Feature A's 12 signs, family history, pain and exclusions, with worked cases and pitfalls.

hsd.title: hEDS vs HSD: hypermobility spectrum disorder subtypes explained
hsd.description: How hypermobility spectrum disorder differs from hypermobile EDS: the four HSD subtypes, a case-sorting game, clinic data and why care is largely shared.

differential.title: EDS differential diagnosis: Marfan, Loeys-Dietz and vEDS red flags
differential.description: How EDS differs from Marfan, Loeys-Dietz, OI, cutis laxa, Stickler and fibromyalgia: a feature matrix, vascular red flags and a teaching test pathway.

joints.title: EDS joints: subluxation, dislocation and hypermobile joint instability
joints.description: Animated shoulder, knee, kneecap and finger under load: why lax tissue subluxes and dislocates in EDS and HSD, plus a cited body map of where joints give way.

pain.title: EDS pain and fatigue: phases, mechanisms and pacing in hEDS and HSD
pain.description: How pain and fatigue change from childhood to later life in hypermobile EDS, the four pain mechanisms with evidence labels, pacing, and cited prevalence data.

skin.title: EDS skin: stretchy skin, atrophic scars and bruising by type
skin.description: Animated skin test for classical, vascular and hypermobile EDS: the 1.5 cm cut-off, atrophic scars, easy bruising, published wound care and a matching quiz.

autonomic.title: POTS and EDS: tilt-table test, thresholds and the hEDS link
autonomic.description: How POTS is defined (a heart-rate rise of 30 bpm, 40 in teens), an animated tilt-table test, a stand-test teaching tool and the evidence linking it to hEDS.

gut.title: EDS gut, bladder and MCAS: what the evidence shows
gut.description: Reflux, gastric emptying, IBS, constipation, prolapse and bladder symptoms in hypermobile EDS, evidence-labelled, and a balanced look at the MCAS debate.

vascular.title: Vascular EDS (vEDS): COL3A1, artery rupture, survival and celiprolol
vascular.description: Vascular EDS explained: how COL3A1 weakens artery walls, risk of rupture by age and variant, emergency card, surveillance, pregnancy and the celiprolol trial.

physio.title: EDS physiotherapy and exercise: what the trials show
physio.description: Exercise for hEDS and HSD: a published 16-week strength programme animated, pacing vs boom-bust, every trial compared, and safe-activity advice by EDS type.

meds.title: EDS medicines: pain, POTS and celiprolol for vascular EDS
meds.description: Treatment ladders for EDS pain, POTS and vascular EDS with evidence levels, the celiprolol BBEST and ARCADE trials person by person, and doses as published.

surgery.title: EDS surgery and anaesthesia: airway, positioning, local anaesthetics
surgery.description: Surgery in Ehlers-Danlos syndromes by type: airway, positioning, lines, bleeding, wound closure, vEDS precautions, local anaesthetic response and dental care.

frontier.title: EDS research: hEDS genes, criteria revision and vEDS trials
frontier.description: Timeline of EDS research since 2017: the HEDGE gene study, KLK15, vascular EDS trials such as DiSCOVER, mouse studies, and how to read research claims.

living.title: Living with EDS: school, work, sport by type and mental health
living.description: Life with Ehlers-Danlos syndromes from school to parenthood: published supports, sport advice for hEDS, cEDS and vEDS, diagnostic delay and peer support.

pregnancy.title: EDS and pregnancy: risks by type, vascular EDS and inheritance odds
pregnancy.description: Pregnancy with hEDS, classical or vascular EDS week by week: published risks, planning steps, conflicting data and the 50% or 25% odds of passing EDS on.

nursing.title: Nursing care in Ehlers-Danlos syndromes: ward guide and care plan
nursing.description: EDS nursing from admission to discharge: skin and tape, BP cuffs, positioning, local anaesthetic, active stand observations and vascular EDS emergencies.

history.title: History of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome: Ehlers, Danlos, Beighton to 2017
history.description: A timeline you can scrub from 1892 to today: Ehlers and Danlos, the Beighton score, the Berlin, Villefranche and 2017 classifications, and who did what.

review.title: EDS flashcards and mnemonics: Beighton, hEDS criteria and vEDS
review.description: 89 cited flashcards on the Ehlers-Danlos syndromes, 10 mnemonics and an animated Beighton score: collagen, the 13 types, hEDS criteria, POTS and vEDS.

quiz.title: Ehlers-Danlos syndromes quiz: 97 questions with cited answers
quiz.description: Multiple-choice EDS quiz with cited explanations: collagen, 13 types, Beighton and 2017 hEDS criteria, HSD, POTS, vascular EDS, treatment and case vignettes.

glossary.title: EDS glossary: collagen, the 13 types, hEDS criteria and POTS terms
glossary.description: Searchable glossary of 156 Ehlers-Danlos syndromes terms, from ADAMTS-2 and COL3A1 to Feature A, G-HSD, the tryptase 20% + 2 rule and celiprolol.

sources.title: EDS Companion sources: validated references by research area
sources.description: Every reference behind the EDS Companion, filterable by eight research areas and searchable, each tagged with the database that validated it.
